events.title: v1.8.0.0: Team Battles Added to the Owners Cup
events.summary: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws- Build a team of your raised monsters for 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4 battles. The full game’s Owners Cup offers team battles alongside duels, battle royales, and tournaments. Combine stats and skills as you arrange teams A and B, then watch every monster act on its own. Follow each team’s survivors and HP alongside individual monster details, and review the results and replays. This is an offline mode using your own monsters and monsters you have downloaded. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46

events.title: v1.7.0.0 — Battle fixes and training improvements
events.summary: The free demo of PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-, a monster-raising auto-battler, has been updated to v1.7.0.0. This update fixes battle movement and obstacle rendering, improves training animations, and makes several screens easier to use. What changed Afterimages now correctly reflect monster colors and outfits. Skill impacts, damage, and hit reactions are better synchronized. events.title: Title: v1.6.0.0: UI, Usability and Long-Term Play Improvements
events.summary: We have improved the Home, Training, Schedule and Battle screens to make information easier to read. Selections, filters and scroll positions are now preserved when switching screens. This update also improves save reliability, long-term game performance, and controls for facilities, pairing and the Owners Cup.
